relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a child with an Alexander disease diagnosis and individual-level detail: "A 7-year-old male patient with Alexander’s disease".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; no table transcribed by script (the only table lists anesthetic procedures, not patients, and gives no phenotype data beyond anesthetic parameters). The patient is in scope by diagnosis of Alexander disease; the paper prints no GFAP variant and never states that this patient had genetic testing or carries a GFAP variant (the GFAP statements are general disease background), so no variants row was created and n_patients_reported is null; cohort_size_as_stated = 1 from 'this report only includes 1 subject'. Label 'patient' by rule 5. 18 months is recorded as age at diagnosis (the paper says diagnosed and presented at 18 months); age at onset left not reported. Vital status not stated explicitly, left not reported. Checklist 'cerebral white matter abnormality' left not reported because the paper says only 'white matter abnormalities' without location; the feature row keeps the paper's wording. Hypotensive episodes (most earlier procedures) and 'no significant hypotension' (the EEG-guided procedure) concern different procedures, so both rows are kept with detail; not treated as a contradiction. Autonomic dysfunction checklist left not reported (anesthesia-related hypotension is not orthostatic hypotension). Macrocephaly appears only in a general statement about the disease, not about this patient. No contradictions found.
